messages:
sara (oncall): ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — eu-west-1 GPU pool 'gpu-regen' saturated, queue length rising >12k, tail latencies spiking. Autoscaler attempted scale but hit scale_limit=4. Paging on-call. Please ack.
ops-bot: @channel Incident created: INC-2024-6743 — GPU capacity exhaustion (eu-west-1). Severity: P1. Runbook: gpu-capacity-exhaustion. PagerDuty notification sent.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: On-call sara (oncall) acknowledged incident. Bridge: https://zoom.company/incident-INC-2024-6743
sara (oncall): Acknowledged. Jumping into diagnostics now. Quick ask: any ongoing deploys in eu-west-1?
mike (eng-sre): not aware of deploys. I'm pulling autoscaler logs. Will check mesh and provider errors.
david (infra): Provider shows quota_ok but allocation failures: several provider responses 429 / rate_limited during the provisioning window. Possible burst throttle from CSP.
jen (eng-runtime): Noted backlog on the request queue. KV/cache hit ratio low for recent traffic pattern. Might be a regen workload that misses prefix cache.
carol (product): Any customer-facing impact? We have a tenant with heavy batch requests — could be hitting limits. Eva, any incoming tickets?
eva (cust-succ): We have ~8 customers complaining of timeouts or requests returning 503/429 in EU. Highlighted: tenant acme-inc reported timed-out inference calls. Collecting logs.
mike (eng-sre): autoscaler logs snippet:
```
2024-07-11T02:05:12Z autoscaler: scale_attempt -> +2 nodes
2024-07-11T02:05:42Z provider_api: 429 TooManyRequests
2024-07-11T02:06:05Z autoscaler: rollback -> hit_scale_limit (current_pools=4)
2024-07-11T02:06:10Z autoscaler: failed_provision_count=6
```

sara (oncall): So autoscaler tried, provider throttled, and we also hit our configured scale_limit. Two constraints. Prioritize: short-term mitigate customer impact; then mitigation of autoscaler limit and provider rate handling.
david (infra): Immediate mitigation path: 1) request emergency quota bump with CSP (already opened ticket), 2) temporarily increase scale_limit to +2 (manual override), 3) divert non-EU traffic to other regions via routing policy. Doing (2) now.
jen (eng-runtime): Note: increasing scale_limit will only work if provider allows allocations. Also we can enable degraded-mode: shed low-priority tenants and pause batch jobs. I can push a quick policy change to evict 'low-priority' queue.
mike (eng-sre): I'm enabling eviction policy now for transient tenants: command:
```
./opsctl queue-shed --region eu-west-1 --policy low-priority --threshold 1000
```
sara (oncall): Good. Apply, and mark tenants evicted list. Also roll a temporary routing rule to send new requests from region eu-west to eu-north for gold customers only? Carol, can you confirm list of gold customers to keep in-region?
carol (product): Gold: acme-inc, lumin, zeta-analytics. Prioritize those. For others, allow reroute.
eva (cust-succ): Notifying acme-inc that we’re mitigating and may see retries. They want ETA.
sara (oncall): ETA for initial mitigation (eviction + routing) = ~7 minutes. Will update.
ops-bot: action: manual_scale_override applied by david. new_scale_limit=6 (temp), expires=2024-07-11T03:00:00Z.
mike (eng-sre): Provider is still returning some throttles but node allocations started to succeed for 2/4 attempts. New capacity coming up slowly. Observability: queue dropped from 12k -> 6k in 5m.
jen (eng-runtime): Degraded-mode eviction pushed. Low-priority queue size dropped, tail latencies improving. Implemented cache prefix warming for suspected regen jobs (best-effort).
sara (oncall): Customer impact update: acme-inc still seeing intermittent timeouts but fewer. Overall error rate in EU fell from 18% -> 5% after mitigation.
eva (cust-succ): Acme acknowledges mitigation message. They're stable for now but want postmortem.
david (infra): CSP responded: temporary burst throttle due to backend maintenance window; quota team accepted expedited allocation request — expect stable allocations within 30m. We should keep manual_override in place until then.
mike (eng-sre): Root causes emerging: 1) traffic surge with poor prefix cache hit for regen workloads; 2) provider transient rate limits during our autoscaler bursts; 3) conservative scale_limit prevented immediate recovery.
carol (product): Need comms for customers re: degraded performance window and action items. I'll draft a short status.
sara (oncall): Incoming action items we should capture:
- AJ1: Adjust autoscaler logic to implement exponential backoff + retry for provider 429s (owner: mike).
- AJ2: Increase default scale_limit for high-risk regions during scheduled maintenance windows or add dynamic override path (owner: david).
- AJ3: Add prioritized-eviction policy to handle regen/batch bursts automatically (owner: jen).
- AJ4: Cache prefix warming heuristics for known regen workloads + prewarm on ramp (owner: eng-ml, assigned later).
- AJ5: Customer comms and postmortem writeup (owner: carol + sara).
- AJ6: Update runbook to include provider throttle detection and immediate escalation path (owner: ops).

mike (eng-sre): I'll file PRs for AJ1 and link autoscaler logs.
david (infra): I'll follow up with CSP ticket and request formal notification window avoidance.
jen (eng-runtime): I'll add automated eviction rule and test in staging.
carol (product): I'll draft customer note and a postmortem skeleton.
sara (oncall): For incident timeline: root at 1749991111, mitigations applied by 1749991320, manual scale override at 1749991340; queue back to normal by 1749991445. Keeping this thread open for postmortem follow-ups.
eva (cust-succ): Logged impacted customers list into the incident doc.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-6743 updated: status -> mitigated. Postmortem required.
sara (oncall): Thanks team. We'll schedule a 30-min retro tomorrow morning with infra + runtime + eng-sre + product. Assigning owners as discussed. Close the live thread once postmortem link posted. :thumbsup:
